test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under The National Air Sports Policy 2022 there will be ______ -tier governance structure for air sports in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Four**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Minister of Civil Aviation **Jyotiraditya Scindia** launched the National Air Sport Policy (NASP) 2022.
 
• It has been established to develop **top-notch air sports facilities, equipment, trainers, and service**s.
 
• **Adopt international best practices** for safety, including but not limited to air sports operations, equipment, maintenance, and training.
 
• Improve the performance and participation of Indian athletes in** international air sports events**.
 
• **Promote air sports** culture throughout the country. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The policy will cover the following air sports in India:** 

 
 
• Aero modelling and model rocketry
 
• Aerobatics
 
• Gliding and powered gliding
 
• Parachuting (including skydiving, BASE jumping, wing suits, etc.)
 
• Paragliding and para motoring (including powered parachute trikes etc.)
 
• Rotorcraft (including auto gyro)
 
 
 
• The supreme governing body is the **Air Sports Federation of India** **(ASFI)**.
 
• **Regional or State and Union Territory level units** of the national air sports associations, as appropriate (e.g. West/South/North East, etc.).
 
• National associations for** individual air sports** or a set of air sports.
